items.title: Inventory B-12f3 local DONE evidence and Authority boundary
items.context: Inspect B-12f3 summary, delivery, validation, and recorded Authority dry-run outcome through Lattice commands only. Establish the expected Authority claim target and distinguish local Non-authority evidence from receipt-backed Authority Server proof.
items.userSees: User sees "B-12f3 Authority boundary inventory: local DONE=true; receiptVerified=false; authorityDone=false; fullAuthorityDone=false" with source commands listed.

happy.desc: B-12f3 local lifecycle DONE evidence is inventoried from Lattice commands without reading story files directly.

edge.desc: Inventory distinguishes local Non-authority lifecycle evidence from Authority Server receipt-backed proof.

adversarial.desc: Inventory does not rewrite B-12f3 history or convert previous dry-run fail-closed evidence into Authority completion.

items.title: Run Authority Server path or record fail-closed blocker
items.context: Using the configured root authority_trust.env defaults, attempt the appropriate Authority Server status/policy/receipt path for B-12f3. If URL/key/actor/runner/receipt prerequisites are missing, capture structured fail-closed evidence with authorityDone=false and fullAuthorityDone=false rather than fabricating completion.
items.userSees: User sees either "Authority Server path verified: receiptVerified=true receiptId=<id>" or "Authority proof blocked: missing actor key/runner id/gate_decision receipt; authorityDone=false; fullAuthorityDone=false".

happy.desc: Authority status/policy/receipt path is attempted with configured trust env through redacted CLI commands.

edge.desc: If actor key, runner id, session, job, or receipt prerequisites are missing, the result is recorded as blocked_classified rather than pass.

adversarial.desc: No command output or evidence prints secrets or claims receiptVerified/authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone without verified gate_decision receipt proof.

items.title: Produce final B-12f3 Authority audit result
items.context: Write the final audit outcome as Lattice evidence and summary: either receipt-backed Authority proof verified, or blocked_classified with exact missing prerequisites. Preserve host-neutral semantics and make clear that local lifecycle DONE is not Authority Server DONE.
items.userSees: User sees final audit line: "B-12f3 Authority audit result: VERIFIED receiptId=<id>" or "B-12f3 Authority audit result: BLOCKED missing prerequisites; local DONE remains Non-authority".

happy.desc: Final audit result summarizes exactly whether receipt-backed Authority proof was verified or blocked.

edge.desc: Summary preserves the distinction between local DONE and Authority Server DONE for B-12f3.

adversarial.desc: Delivery and summary text do not overclaim Authority completion, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone when receipt proof is absent.
